name: Planka
description: Kanban board for project and task management.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      BASE_URL: {{env.BASE_URL}}
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://planka:{{envRaw.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-db:5432/planka"
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/user-avatars:/app/public/user-avatars
      - {{appDataPath}}/project-background-images:/app/public/project-background-images
      - {{appDataPath}}/attachments:/app/private/attachments
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-db
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: planka
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: planka
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
